title: Bechtel Ltd v High Speed Two (HS2) Ltd
description: Bechtel Ltd challenged the award of a construction contract for Old Oak Common station to Balfour Beatty Vinci Systra (BBVS), alleging manifest error in HS2's evaluation and selection, unequal treatment, and lack of transparency. The court found no breach of the Utilities Contracts Regulations 2016, stating that manifest error requires 'something akin to irrationality' and that Bechtel failed to establish any errors or unequal treatment.
